title: Write second review of the revised parallel-jobs design
summary: Add docs/design/reviews/parallel-jobs-review-2.md. It checks each answer to review 1's F1-F8 against the source code and native-pr-landing.md, lists new problems, and ends with a verdict. The design is untouched. CHANGELOG.md gets an entry because past reviews have one.

defaults_applied.how: The review is written so an outside reader can follow it without prior context.
Each status cites a file, function, or section; unmeasured numbers are labelled as estimates.
One new review file plus a changelog entry.
Verification is by git status and git diff on the file set, plus a read of the criteria.
The CHANGELOG convention and the review format were recovered from the repository.

assumptions: Review 1 is docs/design/reviews/parallel-jobs-review-1.md and its findings are labelled F1-F8.
The CHANGELOG.md entry is allowed because existing review files have entries, for example the squash-chain review 2 entry.
Claims in the review cite the source code and docs; any number not measured is labelled as an estimate.
The file follows the format of existing reviews, for example native-pr-landing-review-3.md.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/reviews/parallel-jobs-review-2.md exists and has one assessment per finding F1-F8 of parallel-jobs-review-1.md, each with a status: resolved, partly resolved, or unresolved.
Each F1-F8 assessment cites the source files and functions and the native-pr-landing.md sections it was checked against, and quotes or points to the revised design's answer.
A new-problems section lists each problem with a severity and evidence (file or section), or states that none were found.
The review ends with a verdict that is exactly one of: accept, accept with changes (changes listed), or reject.
CHANGELOG.md has a short entry for the new review, in the style of the existing review entries.
Run git status and git diff --stat: the only changes are the new review file and CHANGELOG.md. docs/design/parallel-jobs.md and every other file are unchanged.

out_of_scope: Any change to source code, tests, or configuration
Fixing the problems the review finds
Changes to review 1 or other earlier reviews
departures: Slightly higher cost than the reference: the review has to read the design, review 1, native-pr-landing.md and several source files.
